# braintrust_dataset (Data Source)

Use this data source to get information about an existing Braintrust [dataset](https://docs.braintrust.dev/annotate/datasets). Look up by `id` or by `name` + `project_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing dataset by ID
data "braintrust_dataset" "by_id" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000" # replace with your dataset UUID
}

# Or look up by name within a project
data "braintrust_dataset" "by_name" {
  project_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000" # replace with your project UUID
  name       = "eval-dataset"
}

output "dataset_name" {
  value = data.braintrust_dataset.by_name.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The unique identifier (UUID) of the dataset. Provide either `id` or `name` (with `project_id`).
- `name` (String) The name of the dataset. Provide `name` together with `project_id`, or use `id` instead.
- `project_id` (String) The project the dataset belongs to. Required when looking up by `name`.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of dataset creation.
- `deleted_at` (String) Date of dataset deletion, or null if the dataset is still active.
- `description` (String) Textual description of the dataset.
- `metadata_json` (String) JSON-encoded dataset metadata object.
- `tags` (List of String) Dataset tags.
- `url_slug` (String) URL slug assigned to the dataset by Braintrust.
- `user_id` (String) Identifies the user who created the dataset.
